name: Free-LLM
description: 79 free LLM API providers & 460+ free models (limits, no-card options) + Free-LLM Router: all of them behind one OpenAI/Anthropic-compatible endpoint with instant failover. Run Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Aider on free models. Gemini, Groq, Mistral, DeepSeek, Qwen & more. Synced daily.
